basis.description: basis=logic-only counts as proof=none for conflict resolution (see effectiveProof).

file.description: Per-verdict file. Legal in al:1; blocks conversion to ac with field-loss (no ac slot).

fix.description: Per-verdict fix note. Legal in al:1; blocks conversion to ac with field-loss (no ac slot).

proof-ref.description: Per-verdict proof reference. A verdict with effectiveProof 'none' and no proof-ref is unproven and never resolves a conflict.

description: JSON representation of a parsed multi-line al:1 pack, as produced by AgentLang.parseAl. The compact single-line form is REMOVED as a valid form for new records: it is not represented here and is blocked with compact-legacy-only; already-published compact Cloud packs expand only via AgentLang.legacyExpandCompact to canonical multi-line form plus a warning. Canonical emit order (fixed key order): agent, task, status, ctx, in, out, verdict, conflict, verify, note, next, done, blocked, id, ts, seq, file, data-class, proof-ref. Escape rule: in values, a backslash before | : = \ or n yields |, :, =, backslash, or newline; any other backslash use blocks. Terminal rule: exactly one of next/done/blocked, unless status is done/blocked (end-state, terminal line optional); status and terminal must agree. Proof-ref rule: a verdict's effectiveProof is 'none' when proof is 'none' or basis is 'logic-only'; a verdict with effectiveProof 'none' and no proof-ref is unproven and never resolves a conflict. id is a pack identity (a repeated id is a replay); seq is a non-negative integer sequence number. Tokens are unmeasured for this schema; length comparisons use chars only.

file.description: Optional record-level source file. A per-verdict file= pair has no ac slot and blocks conversion to ac with field-loss.

id.description: Optional pack identity; a repeated id is a replay and must be rejected by the consumer (see createIdRegistry).

proof-ref.description: Optional record-level proof reference. Also valid as envelope metadata referring to an ac:1 record (see AgentCode.alToAcEnvelope).

verdicts.description: Ordered verdict array; repeats keep input order.

warnings.description: Warning-tier notes only (for example email-warning:<field>). Warning-tier items never block validation; hard secret patterns block before a record is produced.

title: AgentLang al:1 record (multi-line form only)
